paragraphs: Oxa sells self-driving software for industrial vehicles, together with modular autonomy hardware and fleet management software. The company describes that work as the automation of repetitive industrial driving tasks, including towing and carrying goods and monitoring assets and perimeters. Existing vehicles built by OEMs are up-fitted with autonomy hardware so they can run that software.

The customer stories page names DHL Supply Chain, where autonomy is deployed in live airport traffic. It names bp, where the self-driving software runs across refineries and wind and solar farms. It also names Vantec Europe, in autonomous trailer and container shunting.
Alongside the software, Oxa offers services to plan, deploy, manage and scale self-driving fleets. The settings named for these fleets are ports, airports, yards and industrial environments.

quote.text: The universal AI driver for industrial vehicles
